caseName: Hopfmann v. United States Federal Election Commission
caseNameFull: Hopfmann v. United States Federal Election Commission

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Motion of The Free Congress Research and Education Foundation for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of petitioner to defer consideration of the petition for writ of certiorari denied. Certio-rari denied.
